# appgatesdp_discovered_app (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the object.

### Read-Only

- `alias` (String) The alias of the app if access is granted. Supported in API versions: v21.
- `app_type` (String) Type of the app. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `app_type_ports` (List of String) List of ports configured for the app type. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `common_groups` (Attributes List) Common groups of the users which have accessed this app. Supported in API versions: v21, v23. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--common_groups))
- `direction` (String) The direction of the access.
- `entitlement_details` (Attributes) Details of the entitlement configuration for this app. Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlement_details))
- `entitlement_id` (String) The ID of the Entitlement generated when access is granted to this app. Supported in API versions: v21.
- `entitlement_name` (String) The name of the entitlement generated by using Application Discovery. Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25.
- `history` (Attributes List) History of the actions taken on this app. Supported in API versions: v21. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history))
- `hit_chart_data` (List of Map of Number) Data for hit count chart per day.
- `host` (String) Host of the app.
- `ips` (List of String) The IPs used to access the app. Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25.
- `last_accessed_at` (String) Timestamp of the last time the app was accessed by a user.
- `last_analysis_at` (String) Timestamp of the last time the analysis is done for all apps.
- `last_modified` (String) Timestamp of the last modification to this discovered app made through the application discovery page.
- `last_reset_at` (String) Timestamp of the last time the app was reset. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23.
- `originating_entitlements` (Attributes List) The entitlements that were used to access the app Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--originating_entitlements))
- `policies` (Attributes List) List of policies configured for access to this app. Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))
- `policy_id` (String) The ID of the Policy generated when access is granted to this app. Supported in API versions: v21.
- `port` (Number) Port of the app. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23.
- `port_type` (String) Port type of the app. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `ports` (List of String) List of ports associated with this app type. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol used.
- `related_apps` (Attributes List) List of apps related to this app, based on host. Supported in API versions: v24, v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--related_apps))
- `rule` (String) The rule applied.
- `status` (String) Status of the discovered app. Supported in API versions: v21.
- `user_groups` (Attributes) Maps users to group indices, with a corresponding array of group names for lookup. Supported in API versions: v22, v24, v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_groups))
- `users` (Attributes List) Users accessed this app. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))
- `users_count` (Number) Total user count for the app.

### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:
